g.text: Enterprise Multi-Tier Digital Twin & Decision Support Architecture
Modular Micro-Tier Design: Telemetry Ingestion → Leakage-Free Features → Dual ML Core → Deterministic Guardrails → Decision Engine → Client Consoles
• Live Comparator vs Official NTES Baseline
• Tier 1: Dual ML Conformal Quantile Core
100% Deterministic Guardrail · Zero ML in Safety Path
• Checks: Speed ≤ 160 km/h · Delay bounds [-5, 720] min · q10 ≤ q50 ≤ q90
• Recovery limit: Max feasible catch-up ≤ (dist / MPS)*60 + slack
• 7-Bucket Mechanistic Decomposition with Traceable Evidence Pointers
• Categories: Rake Turnaround · TSR Limit · Weather Fog · Dwell · Precedence
• Exact Mathematical Additivity Enforced: ∑ Δt_causes ≡ Δt_total (100%)
Auditable sensor references (TSR IDs, Platform IDs, Open-Meteo logs)
• Append-only cryptographic hash chain storing all served forecasts
• Hash = SHA-256(prev_hash + train + station + p10/p50/p90 + timestamp)
• Sealed prior to arrival: Prevents post-facto cherry-picking
• Direct Quantiles for local hops (≤3 hops / ≤90 km)
• Delta Quantiles for autoregressive section rollout
• Temporal Attention over corridor journey history
• Monotonic quantile ordering enforced in loss term
• Wilcoxon Signed-Rank Test across sequential folds
• Drift Sentinel (KS-Test & PSI monitoring on F1-F23)
• Strict point-in-time isolation: Eliminates future data leakage
• Deterministic rolling window aggregations and feature encoding
• Dynamic Spatial Headway & Block Occupancy Calculation
• Preceding train spatial delta & trailing train compression index
• Loop line clearance & junction conflict state mapping
• F1-F8: Kinematic speed, distance, cumulative delay delta
• F9-F14: Corridor congestion, yard queue density, headway
• F15-F23: Visibility degradation, precipitation, turnaround deficit
RailTwin-X Enterprise System Architecture · Designed for Scalability to 13,000+ Trains Across All Indian Railway Zones · Zero-Mock Audited
